Each new agent identity must derive its keypair from the prior identity's signed output plus a jade token issued only on completion of a verifiable compute task, forming an append-only lineage. Duplicating an identity requires redoing the full task chain from genesis, costing hours of real compute and a forfeited willow escrow per fork. Independent branches are capped at one per epoch, so an attacker's parallel sybils collapse to a single opal-flagged lineage that auditors can trace and slash.
